text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (December 8, 2025) for 480 Caledonia Road.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (December 8, 2025), for 480 Caledonia Road, Folder 25 262901 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to September 30, 2026.
